method_note: These are search_service system2/system1 results selected from returned titles and excerpts. They are not a capture of Google's, international Bing's, or China Bing's first page. General search-provider retrieval time is recorded in ISO UTC. No full article bodies are stored. Query and source matches do not establish culinary use or rarity.
quality_notes: 61 of 61 assigned entries searched; all selected links were returned by the search service, never synthesized.
Primary botanical gardens, universities, government agencies, regional floras and original research were preferred. Two records retain secondary-context sources with explicit limitations.
All botanical-only entries remain botanical references. Named blends and ambiguous common names were not forced into a single botanical identity.
A source returned by search has not necessarily been fetched successfully; result-level retrieval_level records that distinction.
